missing.title: Helm is not installed
missing.text: Releases can be viewed, but changing them and installing charts needs the helm command. Install Helm (it is picked up when you come back to this window) or pick a binary in Settings → Helm. Install guide:
missing.short: Needs Helm — see the hint at the top of the page

releases.title: Releases
releases.emptyText: Releases installed with Helm in the selected namespaces appear here.

details.title: Release {{name}}

hidden.values: Values are hidden. Use the eye button to show them.
hidden.manifest: The manifest is hidden. Use the eye button to show it.

details.noValues: No user values: the release uses the chart's defaults.
details.unreadableText: The stored data of this revision cannot be read.
details.unreadableLatest: Revision {{revision}} cannot be read; showing revision {{shown}}, the latest readable one.
details.nothingReadable: No revision of this release can be read (latest: {{revision}}).

upgrade.title: Edit values of {{name}}
upgrade.chartRefHint: Upgrades with chart {{chart}} {{version}}. Leave empty to reuse the chart stored in the release; a chart with subcharts needs its repository reference, e.g. repo/{{chart}}.
upgrade.done: Release {{name}} upgraded. A new revision was created.
upgrade.failed: Helm could not upgrade the release

rollback.title: Roll back {{name}}?
rollback.text: {{name}} will get a new revision with the chart and values of revision {{revision}}. The resources in the cluster change accordingly.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.text: Release {{name}} in namespace {{namespace}} and every resource it created will be deleted from the cluster. This cannot be undone.
uninstall.failed: Helm could not uninstall the release

confirmName.label: Type the release name ({{name}}) to confirm

charts.title: Charts
charts.noRepos: No chart repositories yet. Add one to search its charts.
charts.loginInUrl: Enter the user name and password in the Username and Password fields, not in the URL.
charts.removeText: Helm forgets the repository {{name}} ({{url}}). Releases installed from it are not affected.

install.invalidName: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and . (at most 53 characters), starting and ending with a letter or digit.
